issue: CSL discounts unlevered FCFF at the cost of equity, then deducts net debt — charges for the debt twice. issue: Bank engine has no §15.5 CET1 constraint. Flat 0.75 payout in every world; book equity compounds at 2.6% p.a. against AIEA at 4.35%, so the implied capital ratio falls every year and the model never notices. Stagflation NPAT falls 57.5% with payout unchanged.
treatment: Warn-only check first (retained earnings vs AIEA growth × RWA density) — zero base-tie risk. Forced payout cut under stress as a separate second step. CET1 and RWA data already in wbc.yaml:538–568.

issue: Stub construction diverges from §7.2. The text says pro-rate the next full year; the engine pro-rates the base year. The engine ties the audited workbook, so the text is what is wrong.
treatment: Fixed 23 Aug 2026 — methodology §7.2 now describes what the engine does (pro-rate the BASE year), with the correction dated and the working-capital run-rate exception cross-referenced.

issue: CSL sits 93% above market — §16.3 requires the structural-reason treatment.
treatment: Price staleness parked by owner decision (D-19) — 15 June 2026 snapshot stands until Ben's feed returns. The §16.3 write-up follows once item 6 lands.

issue: β triangulation honoured in form, but DNL's peer dataset is flagged mock while the ratified β 1.10 narrative cites those peers.
treatment: Done 23 Aug 2026 — D-02 annotated to separate the method from the still-mock peer datasets, and the 'Illustrative mock data' banner is now gated on BW.mock instead of printing unconditionally.

Also duplicated beyond Fable's list: da_pct_revenue, working_capital_change, tax_rate, restructuring_cash_to_come, terminal_ebit_margin.
treatment: Done 23 Aug 2026 — the seven mirrored scalars deleted from normalised_baseline top level, rationale prose moved beside the surviving segment_fcff copy. Regenerating the UI config confirmed nothing read them.

It immediately caught beta/beta_selected in all three companies — the gap check 3 documented as invisible to it — plus DNL's da_pct_revenue mirror; all removed, 20 known duplicates -> 17. The remaining 17 are recorded, several legitimate coincidences and several real (WBC's 1H26 income anchors mirrored between company_position and normalised_baseline) — next tranche.

The old check's silent skip for companies without anchor dates is now an explicit NO_ANCHOR_DATES_YET list with a reason each, so WBC and CSL are visibly exempt rather than invisibly so.

source: Batch 3 item 19, found by the new schema validators
issue: APRA CET1 floor does not reconcile. australian_major_banks.yaml lists regulatory_minimum 8.0% + capital_conservation_buffer 2.5% + countercyclical_buffer 1.0% + d_sib_surcharge 1.0% = 12.5%, against a stated total_floor of 11.5%. The block's own rationale (regionals at 10.5% with no surcharge) implies the countercyclical buffer sits OUTSIDE the stated floor, which reconciles to 11.5%.
treatment: Recorded, not resolved — it is a domain call. The typed schema now requires a components_in_total declaration naming which components the floor comprises, and the file declares minimum + conservation buffer + D-SIB surcharge, which reconciles without changing a number. Stephen to confirm the CCyB genuinely sits outside the floor for this archetype, or correct total_floor to 12.5%. Nothing downstream reads total_floor today, so this is not blocking.
questions: Does the countercyclical buffer sit inside or outside the archetype CET1 floor?
